evals.name: blocking-owner-lands-now-unrelated-owner-survives-restart
evals.prompt: $valcraft:foreman — while delivering T-007, classify two findings: (a) T-003's contract prevents T-007 from satisfying AC-009; (b) an unrelated defect belongs to future T-011 and neither arose from T-007's diff nor blocks T-007. It then applies review-round.md unchanged: a closure check always follows material-finding remediation, and a second full round runs whenever an existing trigger fires, including resolution beyond the evidence-cited scope or an approach change. assertions: Causal routing determines whether the cross-task edit lands now

evals.name: default-branch-resolution-uses-authoritative-precedence
evals.prompt: $valcraft:foreman — foreman_default_branch is absent. Resolve it in four independent repositories: (A) the live origin HEAD symref and the hosting service both name trunk; (B) the live symref is unavailable and the hosting service reports develop as that repository's default; (C) both live sources are unavailable, while cached origin/HEAD and local main name main; (D) the live origin HEAD symref names trunk while the hosting service reports develop. Do not spawn workers. Do not write files. Report only.
evals.expected_output: Foreman resolves A to trunk from the agreeing live sources. It resolves B to develop from the host-reported default because the live symref is unavailable. It stops for C before tracker access, run creation, or dispatch: cached origin/HEAD and a local branch may corroborate a live result but cannot provide the missing value. It stops for D because the live sources disagree. For both stops, Foreman asks for an explicit foreman_default_branch and never guesses another name. The only authorities are the live remote HEAD symref and the same repository's host-reported default branch.
assertions: Agreeing live remote and host sources may resolve a non-conventional branch
The host-reported remote default resolves the branch when the live remote symref is unavailable
Cached origin/HEAD and local branches are corroboration only, never the source of a default
Unavailable or disagreeing live sources stop startup and require an explicit value
Foreman never guesses a different branch name

evals.name: missing-release-branch-disables-release-only-flows
evals.prompt: $valcraft:foreman — foreman_release_branch is absent and the resolved default branch is main. Compare (A) an ordinary reviewed task PR targeting main, (B) a fast-track label, and (C) a direct-write request targeting a release branch. Explain attended and unattended behavior without calling tools.
evals.expected_output: Missing foreman_release_branch means the project has no separate release branch; Foreman does not treat main as a release branch. For A, the ordinary step-10 merge row applies: attended waits and unattended proceeds when the ordinary proceed/wait test and all review/check gates pass. For B and C, the requested release-only flows are unavailable because no release branch is explicitly configured. Foreman reports that configuration is required and does not infer main, create a branch, or fall back to the default-branch flow. A later explicit valid foreman_release_branch enables those flows and remains an override.
assertions: An absent release branch does not turn the default branch into a release branch
Ordinary default-branch merges use the normal approval row
Fast-track is unavailable without an explicit release branch
A direct release-branch write is unavailable without an explicit release branch
Foreman never infers a release branch or falls back from a release-only flow
